messages:
sasha: Quick check — planning to promote quantized MPT-30B (AWQ) to staging. Need signoff on three items: 1) accuracy delta threshold (<=1.5% on our conv eval), 2) calibration dataset used (calib_v4 split) and location, and 3) tokenizer mapping fix (pad/eos id mismatch). PR: https://git.redwood/ml/pulls/4129  

Config snippet I pushed to the PR for review:
```
model:
  path: s3://rw-internal/models/mpt-30b/v2/weights-awq/
quant:
  backend: awq
  precision: int8
  fallback: gptq
calib:
  dataset: s3://rw-datasets/calib_v4
  val_pct: 10
```

Can folks +product give an explicit thumbs? Need to schedule a 2% canary tomorrow morning.

kevin: Where are the GPTQ fallback artifacts (if we need to flip)? also pinging @eli for kv-cache recommendation.

sasha: GPTQ artifacts are at s3://rw-internal/models/mpt-30b/gptq-candidates/ (tag gptq-2026-03-16). PR #4129 includes the small kernel change that makes the two backends runtime-compatible. Also noted tokenizer: HF tokenizer we have uses pad_id=1 while our runtime expects pad_id=0 — I'll add a tokenizer-mapping patch in the PR to avoid retraining.

maya: Ran the calibration job last night (job id 7892). Top-line: AWQ vs float baseline on our conv eval: perplexity +0.9%, Rouge-L -0.8, top-1 accuracy on retrieval tasks -0.4. Safety tests: no new regression in the sampled prompts. Calibration dataset used: s3://rw-datasets/calib_v4/partitions/{train,val,test}

eli: Small infra asks before canary: set `kv_cache_on_init: true` to avoid extra cold-start token latency and cap `batch_size` to 16 for the first 24h of canary. Also recommend enabling the runtime fallback policy to immediate gptq if token-error-rate > 0.5%.

liz: Product signoff — acceptable if overall delta <=1.5% and safety pass holds. :white_check_mark: please include the calibration summary in the rollout notes.

sasha: Thanks all. I'll land the tokenizer-mapping patch, update the PR with calibration metrics, and schedule a 2% canary at 03:30 UTC tomorrow. @kevin can you own monitoring for the first hour? I'll add the canary run id to the rollout ticket.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: canary-id dc-20260317-01, start 03:30 UTC, target 2% traffic, auto-rollback on error-rate > 0.5% or latency > 2x baseline.

kevin: On it — will watch mem/cold-start + token-error-rate. Ping me if fallback triggers and I'll trigger full rollback. :+1:
